name: Dimitris Tsiodras - Proposition de la Commission et amendements
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing a common data platform on chemicals, laying down rules to ensure that the data contained in it are findable, accessible, interoperable and reusable and establishing a monitoring and outlook framework for chemicals
part_text:
The European Parliament wants one shared online system for information on chemicals, run by the European Chemicals Agency. It would bring together data held by EU agencies and the Commission, and let authorities, researchers and the public find and use it. The report also asks for an early warning system for new chemical risks, a public list of planned and ongoing chemical assessments, and better use of independent research. It adds new databases on chemicals in products and on safer alternatives.

- A single EU chemicals database, with new databases on chemicals in products and safer alternatives.
- Authorities, researchers, businesses and the public gain easier access to chemical data.
- Parliament has set its position; talks with EU governments come next.
